checklist: The Edit canvas (roadmap addendum §8): a 2 s drag on exposure and on shadows at 120 values/s through lumina.edit, latency from the look event to the presented frame (p95 ≤ 16 ms on the dev Mac, ≤ 33 ms on the M1 via probe_remote.sh: LUMINA_EDIT_P95), dropped frames during the drag = 0, the rest render after drag end ≤ 120 ms, bases for at most 3 photos and ≤ 300 MB, canvas vs export ΔE median ≤ 0.5. The page has no Edit step yet, so the probe drives lumina.edit itself with the canvas forced up. Folder: LUMINA_EDIT_DIR (probe.sh edit sets it). Run twice: native, and LUMINA_CANVAS=image for the fallback path (reported, not gated).

steps.src: const l=__probe.logic(); const p=l.real[Math.min(1,l.real.length-1)]; window.__editRel=p.path; return lumina.edit.enter(p.path, 'ev:+0.30 con:+10').then(f=>JSON.stringify(f))

steps.what: bases built (or the first image shown)

steps.src: const l=__probe.logic(); const p=l.real[Math.min(2,l.real.length-1)]; const t0=performance.now(); return lumina.edit.enter(p.path).then(()=>lumina.edit.stats()).then(s=>JSON.stringify({switchMs:Math.round(performance.now()-t0),prefetched:s.bases&&s.bases.prefetched,hits:s.bases&&s.bases.hits,resident:s.bases&&s.bases.residentPhotos,mb:s.bases&&Math.round(s.bases.bytes/1048576)}))
